result.reason: The clause substantially tracks the preferred position, including six months of transition assistance, machine-readable export, deletion, and certification. However, it requires data return within 30 days of Customer’s request rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination. More importantly, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content and Customer data, potentially disrupting unaffected Service Option Attachments that remain in force and undermining the original clause’s intent. It should be limited to data associated with the terminated Agreement or Service Option Attachment, with the 30-day period running from the applicable expiry or termination.
